As a Warehouse Associate, each day brings new tasks and challenges. Your responsibilities include:

- Picking and preparing orders for shipment
- Receiving and organizing incoming goods
- Verifying the quantity and quality of received items, and reporting any discrepancies to your supervisor or updating them in the inventory system
- Moving goods within the warehouse using a forklift or getting them ready for shipment
- Managing inventory and order details through computer systems
- Completing shipping documentation
- Ensuring the warehouse remains clean and organized

Your shifts may vary depending on the workload, with both day shifts and staggered shifts (morning/afternoon) available.

Working hours:

- 05:30 - 14:00
- 14:00 - 22:00

What do we expect from you?

- Flexibility and sense of responsibility
- Good command of the English language, Dutch is a plus
- In possession of a forklift certificate or willingness to obtain one
- You like to work together with others and follow safety regulations carefully

Pro Industry

For our client Katoen Natie in Born, we are looking for enthusiastic and motivated Part-Time Warehouse Operatives to strengthen their logistics team during the afternoon shift. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment, staying active throughout the day, and being part of a team that keeps goods moving across Europe? Then this opportunity is for you! Wie zoeken we? As a Warehouse Operative, you play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient flow of goods within the distribution center. Are you full of energy, do you like variety, and do you prefer to be on the move rather than sitting still on a chair? Stop searching! In our warehouse, you can work as an orderpicker for the most fun departments within CB. And the best part of all? You work comfortably in the day shift, so you keep your evenings to yourself! You can work until the end of the year, at least. 🤩

Become an orderpicker at CB. Guaranteed action, variety, and great working hours! 🚀

What we offer
- A nice starting salary of €15.49 per hour (19+)
- 32 to 38 hours of work each week!
- Traveling by OV? Then it will be 100% reimbursed
- Weekly payments
- Opportunities for a permanent contract!
- You will always build up a pension with us

Who you are
As an orderpicker you are a hard worker who is not afraid of a bit of physical work. Furthermore:

- You don't have any vacations planned for August and September due to the busy summer season;
- You speak enough Dutch and/or English to hold a conversation;
- You are available 5 days a week (of which Monday is mandatory);
- You are looking for day shifts (working hours: 08:00 - 16:00);
- You have your own transport or can easily reach the location by public transport.

What will you do
With us, you don't wait for the products to come to you; you hit the road yourself! With a hand scanner and your own trolley, you drive through the warehouse to pick orders. You regularly switch between two departments, which means no two days are ever the same as an orderpicker at CB. You won't be bored! ✨

Where will you work
You will get to work at CB, in the LDC department! A large, logistics stronghold where thousands of packages fly through every day. The atmosphere? Nice and informal, and we like to get things done. You will join a diverse team that works hard, but where there is certainly also space for a joke. Because you alternate between departments, you get to see a lot of the company as an orderpicker and work with many different colleagues. Super
